clue.text: Tree supplying person with wood

parts.note: a man is a person
a grove is a small wood

explanation.surface: A tree that provides someone with timber.
explanation.definitionFit: The mangrove is a tropical tree growing in coastal swamps.

clue.text: Ruin attraction of fairground, being wet underfoot

parts.note: to mar is to spoil or ruin
a coconut shy is a fairground stall where balls are thrown at targets

explanation.surface: A fairground ride spoilt because the ground is waterlogged.
explanation.walkthrough: A coconut shy is a British fairground stall where you throw balls at coconuts. 'being' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Boggy ground, like a marsh, is wet underfoot.

clue.text: Latin cut short without anyone objecting

definitions.meaning: an abbreviated Latin phrase, nemine contradicente

explanation.definitionFit: The abbreviated Latin tag means unanimously, with no one speaking against.

clue.text: Reform here for men under tyranny, at last

definitions.text: Reform here for men under tyranny, at last

indicators.note: reform means the letters are shaped again into a new form
at last picks the final letter of the word tyranny

explanation.surface: The place where men oppressed by a tyrant finally won reform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reform' rearranges MENUNDER plus Y, the last letter of 'tyranny'. Magna Carta, curbing King John's tyranny, was sealed at Runnymede in 1215.
explanation.definitionFit: The meadow by the Thames where Magna Carta was agreed, a landmark of constitutional reform.

clue.text: Triumphant speech making points accepted by numbers of Romans

indicators.note: accepted by means taken inside, so the points sit within the numerals

parts.note: V, I, V, I, D, I, V, I, C, I are Roman numerals
E and N are compass points

explanation.surface: A victory oration that makes its points to crowds of Romans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' is a link. Caesar's boast, I came, I saw, I conquered.
explanation.definitionFit: Julius Caesar's terse report of victory is the classic boast of triumph.

clue.text: Element son regarded with abhorrence

parts.note: odium is hatred or abhorrence

explanation.surface: Some part of a family's son is regarded with loathing.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodium is a chemical element, symbol Na.

clue.text: Old leader of sailors briefly recalled port out East

indicators.note: leader of takes the first letter of the word sailors

parts.note: re-called, called again, is also known as, abbreviated to aka

explanation.surface: A former commander of seamen remembered a harbour in the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' is read as re-called, called another name: also known as, shortened to aka.
explanation.definitionFit: Osaka is a major Japanese port city.

clue.text: Start giving minimal account of visit to restaurant?

definitions.text: giving minimal account of visit to restaurant?
definitions.meaning: split as ..., the briefest report of dining out

explanation.definitionFit: To initiate is to begin; split up it is the terse report in it, I ate.

clue.text: Lots of work, lots of corn

definitions.meaning: a measure of labour, many person-years of effort

explanation.definitionFit: Labour is measured in years per worker; corn grows in ears, so plenty of them.

clue.text: Contemplating how bird gets trapped by weakling

indicators.note: the bird is held inside the weakling, so one word sits within the other

parts.note: a runt is the weakest of a litter, a weakling
the mina (myna) is an Asian starling

explanation.surface: Musing on how a bird came to be caught by a feeble creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'how' is just a link word. MINA is a variant spelling of myna.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruminant describes someone meditative, chewing things over like a cow chewing cud.

clue.text: Denigrate male needing to get straightened out

parts.note: to align is to bring into a straight line

explanation.surface: Belittling a man who needs to be put right.
explanation.definitionFit: To malign is to speak ill of, slander or disparage.

clue.text: One new lift arranged, helping surreptitious access

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: arranged means the letters are set out in another order

parts.note: a ration is a helping or portion

explanation.surface: A newly installed lift makes it easier to sneak in.
explanation.definitionFit: Infiltration is entry gained secretly, as by spies or troops.

clue.text: In attempt to attract attention, rings in? Nonsense

indicators.note: the rings are said to be in, placed inside the call for attention

parts.note: hey is a call used to attract attention
two O shapes look like rings

explanation.surface: Someone shouting to be noticed while bells ring in, which is all nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'In' is a link; the second 'in' puts OO inside HOY.
explanation.definitionFit: Hooey is informal American slang for nonsense or humbug.

clue.text: Cause damage to museum with dreadful lies

parts.note: the V and A is the Victoria and Albert Museum in London

indicators.note: dreadful suggests the letters are in a terrible mess, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone harming a museum by spreading awful falsehoods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' turns LIES into LISE; 'with' is a link. The V and A is London's Victoria and Albert Museum.
explanation.definitionFit: To vandalise is to deliberately damage or deface property.

clue.text: Associate it with sinners' bed, possibly?

definitions.text: Associate it with sinners' bed, possibly?

indicators.note: possibly hints that the letters given could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A suggestion to connect something with the bed of the sinful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges IT and SINNERS BED. In heraldry the bend sinister on a coat of arms is popularly taken to mark illegitimacy, a child of the sinners' bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagonal heraldic band running from top right to bottom left, traditionally linked with bastardy.

clue.text: Of necessity, a child shows such originality

definitions.text: Of necessity, a child shows such originality

parts.words: Of necessity, a child shows such originality
parts.note: plays on the proverb that necessity is the mother of a certain creative thing, so that thing is her child

explanation.definitionFit: Necessity is the mother of creativity's product, the new device or idea.

clue.text: Sharp instrument once used to clear the bar

definitions.meaning: a cutting tool with two blades

definitions.text: once used to clear the bar
definitions.meaning: an old high-jump style with a scissor-like kick over the bar

explanation.definitionFit: A two-bladed cutter, and also a high-jump technique superseded by the Fosbury flop.

clue.text: Girl was thoughtful — like Victoria, allegedly

parts.note: Una is a girl's name
mused means pondered, was thoughtful

explanation.surface: A girl lost in thought, rather like a queen.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen Victoria is said to have remarked 'We are not amused'.
explanation.definitionFit: Victoria supposedly declared she was not entertained, so not pleased.

clue.text: This type revives no act that's revolutionary

indicators.note: revolutionary hints that the letters are turned over and recast into new order

explanation.surface: A traditionalist who refuses to bring back any radical measure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' rearranges REVIVES NO ACT; 'that's' is a link. The whole clue also describes the answer: such a person revives no revolutionary act.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditionalist, the sort who resists change, is this type of person.

clue.text: Star group including a strident female

indicators.note: including means the constellation takes the letter inside it

parts.note: Virgo is a constellation, a group of stars

explanation.surface: A celebrity band that features a loud-mouthed woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star group' suggests a pop band, but it is a constellation.
explanation.definitionFit: A virago is a domineering, shrewish woman.

clue.text: To be fair, partner's duties should benefit

parts.note: taken as the word be
a fair partner takes on a half share of the duties

explanation.surface: A partner sharing chores fairly should gain from it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should' is a link. The definition is the sense in 'on behalf of', meaning for the benefit of.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting on someone's behalf is acting in their interest or for their benefit.

clue.text: Images artist combined with musical composition

indicators.note: composition signals the letters are composed afresh into a new arrangement

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

explanation.surface: Pictures by a painter set alongside a work of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' rearranges MUSICAL into SIMULAC; 'combined with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Simulacra are likenesses or representations, plural of simulacrum.

clue.text: Accommodate Duke in private part of house

indicators.note: in places the duke inside the theatre box

parts.note: a loge is a private box in a theatre auditorium

explanation.surface: Putting up a nobleman in a secluded corner of the mansion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house' suggests a home, but it is a theatre auditorium.
explanation.definitionFit: To lodge someone is to house or put them up.

clue.text: Beak imprisons one for racket

indicators.note: imprisons means the outer word holds the other inside it

parts.note: beak is slang for a nose
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A magistrate jails someone for running a scam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beak' suggests a British slang magistrate and 'racket' a criminal scheme, but beak is the nose and racket is din.
explanation.definitionFit: A racket is a loud din, which is noise.

clue.text: Picked for team in appropriate position in field

definitions.meaning: on one's side, selected to play
in football or rugby, not offside, in a legal position

explanation.definitionFit: A player chosen is on side; a player in a legal position is not offside.

clue.text: Monkey about repeatedly in lake

parts.note: the titi is a small South American monkey

indicators.note: repeatedly means the short word for about appears twice in a row

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: An ape clowning around again and again in a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: CA is the abbreviation of circa, about; doubled it gives CACA.
explanation.definitionFit: Titicaca is the large lake on the border of Peru and Bolivia.

clue.text: Port developed for transportation

parts.note: looks like a harbour built for shipping, but means an Australian city founded as a penal colony for convicts transported from Britain

explanation.definitionFit: The Australian city grew from a convict settlement for prisoners sentenced to transportation.

clue.text: Switch positions from time to time

definitions.meaning: the two settings of a switch

explanation.definitionFit: A switch is either live or dead; something happening intermittently happens sporadically.
